name: Topic marquee rows
purpose: Conveys the breadth of a course library or programme with endlessly scrolling rows of topic pills.
description: One component with a `variant` prop. header (/lms/small-business): centred serif H2 and a grey paragraph with one inline link, three full-width rows of white-text pills, then a primary + dark button pair. plain (/mentoring, four instances, `set` 1-4): just two rows of grey-text pills inside padding-global, each placed straight after a wow2col block. Each row is an edge-faded (0 -> 15% / 85% -> 0 mask) overflow-hidden strip whose track holds the pill list twice and scrolls with a CSS keyframe loop; rows alternate direction.
